art_note: Clean studio product shots, but lacks model presentation and high-end lighting to achieve a luxury campaign aesthetic.
desc_en: Elongated silhouette tailored with a mid-rise waist and a fluid flared cut. The construction offers a sophisticated fit that moves naturally with the body. Detailed with functional front pockets and an all-over print that defines the piece. A versatile garment to transition between occasions with absolute elegance. Made to order. Worldwide shipping available.
desc_es: Silueta alargada diseñada con una cintura media y un corte acampanado fluido. La confección ofrece un ajuste sofisticado que acompaña el movimiento natural del cuerpo. Detalle de bolsillos frontales funcionales y un estampado integral que define la pieza. Una prenda versátil para transcurrir entre ocasiones con absoluta elegancia. Hecho bajo pedido. Envío mundial disponible.
